leadText: Yumi Kakazu (かかず　ゆみ Kakazu Yumi) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Yumi Kakazu (かかず　ゆみ Kakazu Yumi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kakazu was born on June 18, 1973, in what was once , , with the kanji of 嘉数由美. She became a voice actress as an adult and voiced several roles in Japanese anime series. She joined during the original series, with her most notable role being that of Olivine City Gym Leader Jasmine during the original and . Kakazu is currently affiliated with Atomic Monkey. She was married and has two children.
